propositions: Closed bugs lacking close_class must be classified via structural signals only: revert of STATUS/COMMITS event → regression, plan-review BLOCK verdict → plan_defect, gate_error_v1 ERROR record → env_integration, otherwise → undetermined.

Backfilled classifications must be written to .rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson as NDJSON records with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified, segregated from authoritative close_class values.
The backfill script must be idempotent by ticket_id: skip bugs already in the artifact and bugs with existing state[close_class], support --dry-run mode.

Only reverts targeting STATUS or COMMITS event types (not COMMENT/LINK) qualify as substantive regression evidence; plan-review BLOCK signals must be read via all_review_results; gate_error_v1 signals require raw event-file scan of *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json.
.gitignore must be updated to track .rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson via negation (!.rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson) past the blanket .rebar/* ignore.

Test suite (tests/scripts/test_backfill_bug_class.py and tests/scripts/test_backfill_bug_class_heldout.py) must assert exact close_class values for regression, plan_defect, env_integration, undetermined cases and verify skipping of bugs with existing close_class.
